description: This file defines the ExternalUserTurnStopStrategy class, which manages user turn stopping logic based on external frames and asynchronous event handling within a speech processing pipeline.

classes.name: ExternalUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that stops user turns based on external frames and asynchronous event handling, relying on external signals to determine when a user has stopped speaking.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with optional timeout and additional keyword arguments.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the strategy to its initial conditions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the strategy with a provided task manager, creating an internal task.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources, including cancelling the internal task.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to update internal state based on frame type.

methods.name: _handle_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when user starts speaking, setting internal flag.

methods.name: _handle_user_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when user stops speaking, updating flags and possibly triggering turn stop.

methods.name: _handle_interim_transcription
methods.description: Handles interim transcription frames, marking interim results as seen.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles final transcription frames, appending text and resetting interim results.

methods.name: _task_handler
methods.description: Asynchronous loop monitoring transcription events to determine when to stop user turn.

methods.name: _maybe_trigger_user_turn_stopped
methods.description: Checks conditions and triggers user turn stopped event if criteria are met.
